author: Insta360
description:
"I'm showing people that ability is more important than the disability."

After a motorcycle accident left Anthony paralyzed from the waist down, he was told watercraft racing was out of the question. Today, he's competing—and winning—at the highest level.

With his Insta360 Ace Pro 2 and X5 along for the ride, we got a closer look at the preparation, passion, and determination that drive Anthony every time he hits the water.

Huge thanks to @anthonyradetic1559, Bax Films and New Take Films 🙌
